The transformation rule inferred from the demonstrations:

- The 7x25 grid contains four 5x5 panels separated by a border.
- The first panel is a separator indicator: it shows a straight dividing line and a marker on one side.
- The second and third panels are two 5x5 patterns.
- The fourth panel is filled by clipping the second pattern to the marker side of the line (including the line) and clipping the third pattern to the opposite side (including the line). If both would occupy the same cell on the line, the second pattern’s color wins.

For query0:
- First panel’s separator corresponds to the vertical center line, with the marker side being the right side.
- Therefore, take the second panel’s 3-colored cells on the right side (columns 2–4 within the 5x5 panel).
- Take the third panel’s 7-colored cells on the left side (columns 0–1 within the 5x5 panel).
- The middle column is the line; there are no conflicting non-background cells in this query.

[5,7,3,7,5]
[5,5,5,5,5]
[7,3,5,3,5]
[7,5,3,5,5]
